reason: A compatibility bridge that loads pi coding-agent TypeScript extensions and maps their tools, commands, events, shell execution, and agent interactions into DeepSeek Harness through Cordis.

summaries.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 中通过 Cordis 桥接并运行 pi coding-agent 的 TypeScript 扩展。
summaries.en: Runs pi coding-agent TypeScript extensions inside DeepSeek Harness through a Cordis-based compatibility bridge.

capabilities: Loads and runs TypeScript pi extensions
Bridges extension tools and commands into DeepSeek Harness
Registers and handles agent and tool lifecycle events
Can invoke shell execution through the bridged pi.exec interface
Can send follow-up or steer messages to agents
May interact with users through an optional questions provider

reasons.code: bridges shell and agent control capabilities
